title: Biased Fourier coefficient bound
statement: Let $p_i\\in(0,1)$ for each coordinate $i$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ under the independent biased sign distribution, using the standardized coordinate monomials, is at most $\\left(\\prod_{i\\in S}\\sqrt{4p_i(1-p_i)}\\right)\\|f\\|_\\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
